title: Index trim-plan runs whose results live in S3
heading: The Index Can Be Rebuilt From S3, Except for Runs Still Waiting
cases: a poll finds a run's result object and records its status, key and cost
the best run of a survey is the cheapest of its finished runs with a plan
a run whose result object does not exist yet stays submitted
a run already recorded answers from the index, even if its object is gone
a run id the index never saw is unknown
infeasible and failed runs, which have no plan, are never the best run
each survey digest has its own best run, and equal costs go to the lower run id
